chapters.text: Leads by source and stage, conversion, agent leaderboard and won value.
Open Reports. Pick the date range and branch at the top.
Charts show leads by source and stage; the leaderboard ranks agents by calls, conversions and won deals.
Super Admins also get Agent performance with each agent's calls per day and follow-up discipline.

Agent performance → Leads by stage: each agent's leads in every stage (All their leads now, or Came in this period), with totals. Click a number to open those leads; click a name for their page, which also shows how many leads they moved into each stage in the period.
Export any report to a spreadsheet.
